items.title: Is Accenture's Business Falling As Fast As Its Stock?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) trades at $179.03, about 53% below its two-year high, the price of a business the market thinks is ending. Over the last twelve months, it generated $12.58 billion of free cash flow, a yield of 11.5% on its market value against a 4.4% median for the S&P 500. Both facts are true. The argument between them is about growth.

items.title: The Business Accenture Now Mentions In Passing
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) is redirecting where its next growth comes from, and the business underneath is in decent shape. What deserves a second look is what got left behind. Two years ago management was presenting a learning arm it had built itself. On the June 2026 call it survived as one item in a list.

items.summary: Accenture's consulting weakness sits in large-enterprise discretionary budgets, and its clearest upside case is a mid-market push that does not need them to thaw.
